fact: Article 27 of Loi N° 027/2023 on cybersecurity and cybercrime (promulgated 11 July 2023, published in Journal Officiel N°218 bis of 15 July 2023) requires data judged confidential or sensitive under its article 22 to be hosted exclusively on national territory, unless the competent administrative authority grants a written derogation.
system: Loi N° 027/2023 (cybersécurité et lutte contre la cybercriminalité), article 27
